find: return wall(c, r) && wall(c + 1, r) && wall(c - 1, r) && wall(c, r + 1) && wall(c, r - 1);
replace: return wall(c, r) && wall(c + 1, r) && wall(c - 1, r) && wall(c, r + 1);
why: The interior test forgets the neighbour above, so a wall cell with wall to its left, right and below counts as interior: the top row of every horizontal bar two cells thick and the top-middle cell of a 3x3 block read as interior, a 2x3 slab stops being thin, and every shipped board's interior share rises (vs-duel-01's 0.0940 to 0.1880, vs-quad-01's 0.3405 to 0.4229). Issue #1065's band is read off that share, so the gate would admit boards whose masses are only slabs.
